bug_fix_details.original_issue: Activity Log section in Teacher Full Review was crashing with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error
bug_fix_details.root_cause: The wp_audit array contains entries with details field as empty object {}. React cannot render objects as children. Line 1043 was doing {w.details || ''} but {} is truthy so it tried to render the object.
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed to: {typeof w.details === 'string' ? w.details : (w.details && Object.keys(w.details).length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(w.details) : '')}
bug_fix_details.verification: Activity Log section now renders correctly with 50 audit entries
